skill_name: Design a game for children and describe the basic rules.
workflow: The game is called Catch the Ant. The goal of the game is for each player to catch as many ants as they can in a certain amount of time. Each player begins with three "ants" (which could be circles or whatever else) and each of the ants is marked with a unique color. On a player’s turn, they throw a "net" (which could be a loop made of yarn or some other material) at a certain spot on the playing field.
